name: megascenes-birthday-photoshoot
description: Create birthday photos of yourself from your own photo in your MegaScenes library: the same face with balloons, a cake and candles or a glam party backdrop.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a selfie or a portrait of yourself from your MegaScenes library and choose the birthday scene: gold number balloons and confetti, blowing out the candles on a cake, a pink glam backdrop, a candid party shot, an editorial studio portrait. You get a picture that keeps your face, in the scene, outfit and style you chose.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the picture needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The picture opens in the chat and stays in your library next to your photo.

For your birthday post, profile pictures and party invitations.

Limitations: only from your own photo or one of someone who agreed to it, never of a famous person; no swimwear, underwear or sensual shots. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Place you in a birthday scene and outfit
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a birthday photo of me with gold balloons and confetti from my latest MegaScenes selfie
Put me in front of a pink glam birthday backdrop in a sparkly dress
Create a candid photo of me blowing out the candles on a cake

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a birthday photo of me with gold balloons and confetti from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one birthday photo needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a birthday photoshoot here?
positive.expected_behavior: The birthday photoshoot models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a candid photo of me blowing out the candles on a cake from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my birthday photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my birthday photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
